body.summary: PLAN4 rework in progress: T1/T2 passed; T3 now verifies original source stages after actual final writer closure and disposes only closed original-capability stages with bounded nofollow checks and directory-only write restoration. Tests cover source timing, authentication/parsers, cancellation, protected discard, owner loss and late quarantine; publication fixtures have awaited cleanup only, with T4 publication behavior still pending. T4-T10, full scoped regression and current macOS/Linux VM qualification remain required before final Story BUILD approval.
